verses.original: וַ֠יִּשְׁלַח חִירָם מֶֽלֶךְ־ צֹ֥ר מַלְאָכִים֮ אֶל־ דָּוִיד֒ וַעֲצֵ֣י אֲרָזִ֔ים וְחָרָשֵׁ֣י קִ֔יר וְחָרָשֵׁ֖י עֵצִ֑ים לִבְנ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ בָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ḥī·rå̄m me·leḵ- ṣōr mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- dā·wîḏ wa·‘ă·ṣê ’ă·rā·zîm wə·ḥā·rā·šê qîr wə·ḥā·rā·šê ‘ê·ṣîm liḇ·nō·wṯ lōw bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David along with cedar logs stonemasons . . . and carpenters . . . to build a palace for him
verses.literalPt: Hirão, rei de Tiro, enviou mensageiros a Davi, e cedros, e pedreiros, e carpinteiros para lhe edificarem uma casa.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣דַע דָּוִ֔יד כִּֽי־ הֱכִינ֧וֹ יְהוָ֛ה לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּֽי־ נִשֵּׂ֤את לְמַ֙עְלָה֙ מַלְכוּת֔וֹ בַּעֲב֖וּר עַמּ֥וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ḏa‘ dā·wîḏ kî- hĕ·ḵî·nōw Yah·weh lə·me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl kî- niś·śêṯ lə·ma‘·lāh mal·ḵū·ṯōw ba·‘ă·ḇūr ‘am·mōw yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And David realized that the LORD had established him as king over Israel and had highly exalted his kingdom for the sake of His people Israel
verses.literalPt: Percebeu Davi que Jeová o tinha estabelecido como rei sobre Israel, porque o seu reino tinha sido muito exaltado por amor do seu povo de Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח דָּוִ֥יד ע֛וֹד נָשִׁ֖ים בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיּ֧וֹלֶד דָּוִ֛יד ע֖וֹד בָּנִ֥ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ dā·wîḏ ‘ō·wḏ nā·šîm bî·rū·šā·lim way·yō·w·leḏ dā·wîḏ ‘ō·wḏ bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: And David took more wives in Jerusalem and became the father of more sons and daughters
verses.literalPt: Tomou ainda Davi, em Jerusalém, outras mulheres e gerou ainda filhos e filhas.

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת הַיְלוּדִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיוּ־ ל֖וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם שַׁמּ֣וּעַ וְשׁוֹבָ֔ב נָתָ֖ן וּשְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ hay·lū·ḏîm ’ă·šer hā·yū- lōw bî·rū·šā·lim šam·mū·a‘ wə·šō·w·ḇāḇ nā·ṯān ū·šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: These are the names of the children born - to him in Jerusalem Shammua Shobab Nathan Solomon
verses.literalPt: Estes são os nomes dos filhos que lhe nasceram em Jerusalém: Samua, Sobabe, Natã e Salomão;

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים כִּי־ נִמְשַׁ֨ח דָּוִ֤יד לְמֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּעֲל֥וּ כָל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אֶת־ דָּוִ֑יד וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע דָּוִ֔יד וַיֵּצֵ֖א לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·mə·‘ū p̄ə·liš·tîm kî- nim·šaḥ dā·wîḏ lə·me·leḵ ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘ă·lū ḵāl pə·liš·tîm lə·ḇaq·qêš ’eṯ- dā·wîḏ way·yiš·ma‘ dā·wîḏ way·yê·ṣê lip̄·nê·hem
verses.literal: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel they all went in search of him but David learned of this and went out to face them
verses.literalPt: Quando os filisteus ouviram que Davi tinha sido ungido rei sobre Israel, subiram todos em busca de Davi; o que ouvindo Davi, saiu contra eles.

verses.literal: Now the Philistines had come and raided the Valley of Rephaim
verses.literalPt: Ora, os filisteus tinham vindo e feito uma arremetida no vale de Refaim.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֨ל דָּוִ֤יד בֵּאלֹהִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַאֶֽעֱלֶה֙ עַל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּיִּים וּנְתַתָּ֖ם בְּיָדִ֑י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר ל֤וֹ יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵ֔ה וּנְתַתִּ֖ים בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·’al dā·wîḏ bê·lō·hîm lê·mōr ha·’e·‘ĕ·leh ‘al- pə·liš·tī·yīm ū·nə·ṯat·tām bə·yā·ḏî way·yō·mer lōw Yah·weh ‘ă·lêh ū·nə·ṯat·tîm bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: So David inquired of God Should I go up against the Philistines Will You deliver them into my hand Go replied the LORD for I will deliver them into your hand
verses.literalPt: Então, Davi consultou a Deus, dizendo: Subirei contra os filisteus? E entregá-los-ás nas minhas mãos? Respondeu-lhe Jeová: Sobe, porque os entregarei nas tuas mãos.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲל֥וּ בְּבַֽעַל־ פְּרָצִים֮ וַיַּכֵּ֣ם שָׁ֣ם דָּוִיד֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד פָּרַ֨ץ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֧ים אֶת־ אוֹיְבַ֛י בְּיָדִ֖י כְּפֶ֣רֶץ מָ֑יִם עַל־ כֵּ֗ן קָֽרְא֛וּ שֵֽׁם־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בַּ֥עַל פְּרָצִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·lū bə·ḇa·‘al- pə·rā·ṣîm way·yak·kêm šām dā·wîḏ way·yō·mer dā·wîḏ pā·raṣ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- ’ō·wy·ḇay bə·yā·ḏî kə·p̄e·reṣ mā·yim ‘al- kên qā·rə·’ū šêm- ham·mā·qō·wm ha·hū ba·‘al pə·rā·ṣîm
verses.literal: So David and his men went up to Baal-perazim where he defeated the Philistines and said Like a bursting flood God has burst out against my enemies by my hand So . . . they called . . . that place Baal-perazim
verses.literalPt: Subiram a Baal-Perazim, e ali os feriu Davi, que disse: Por minha mão Deus fez brecha nos meus inimigos, como uma brecha feita por águas. Pelo que chamaram àquele lugar Baal-Perazim.

verses.original: וַיַּעַזְבוּ־ שָׁ֖ם אֶת־ אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד וַיִּשָּׂרְפ֖וּ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘az·ḇū- šām ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem way·yō·mer dā·wîḏ way·yiś·śā·rə·p̄ū bā·’êš
verses.literal: There the Philistines abandoned their gods and David ordered that they be burned in the fire
verses.literalPt: Ali, deixaram os seus deuses, que, por ordem de Davi, foram queimados a fogo.

verses.literal: Once again . . . the Philistines raided the valley
verses.literalPt: Tornaram os filisteus a fazer uma arremetida no vale.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֨ל ע֤וֹד דָּוִיד֙ בֵּֽאלֹהִ֔ים וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹ֥א תַֽעֲלֶ֖ה אַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם הָסֵב֙ מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וּבָ֥אתָ לָהֶ֖ם מִמּ֥וּל הַבְּכָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·’al ‘ō·wḏ dā·wîḏ bê·lō·hîm way·yō·mer lōw hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lō ṯa·‘ă·leh ’a·ḥă·rê·hem hā·sêḇ mê·‘ă·lê·hem ū·ḇā·ṯā lā·hem mim·mūl hab·bə·ḵā·’îm
verses.literal: So David again inquired of God who answered him Do not march up after them but circle around them and attack them in front of the balsam trees
verses.literalPt: De novo, consultou Davi a Deus, que lhe disse: Não subirás após eles; retira-te e vem contra eles por diante das balsamárias.

verses.original: וִ֠יהִי כְּֽשָׁמְעֲךָ֞ אֶת־ ק֤וֹל הַצְּעָדָה֙ בְּרָאשֵׁ֣י הַבְּכָאִ֔ים אָ֖ז תֵּצֵ֣א בַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה כִּֽי־ יָצָ֤א הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ לְהַכּ֖וֹת אֶת־ מַחֲנֵ֥ה פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hî kə·šā·mə·‘ă·ḵā ’eṯ- qō·wl haṣ·ṣə·‘ā·ḏāh bə·rā·šê hab·bə·ḵā·’îm ’āz tê·ṣê ḇam·mil·ḥā·māh kî- yā·ṣā hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā lə·hak·kō·wṯ ’eṯ- ma·ḥă·nêh p̄ə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees move out to battle because this will mean that God has gone out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines
verses.literalPt: Quando ouvires o ruído de marcha nas copas das balsamárias, sairás à peleja, pois Deus saiu diante de ti para ferir o exército dos filisteus.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ דָּוִ֔יד כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖הוּ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיַּכּוּ֙ אֶת־ מַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים מִגִּבְע֖וֹן וְעַד־ גָּֽזְרָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś dā·wîḏ ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wā·hū hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yak·kū ’eṯ- ma·ḥă·nêh p̄ə·liš·tîm mig·giḇ·‘ō·wn wə·‘aḏ- gā·zə·rāh
verses.literal: So David did as God had commanded him and they struck down the army of the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer
verses.literalPt: Fez Davi como Jeová lhe havia ordenado; e feriram o exército dos filisteus desde Gibeão até Gezer.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א שֵׁם־ דָּוִ֖יד בְּכָל־ הָֽאֲרָצ֑וֹת וַֽיהוָ֛ה נָתַ֥ן אֶת־ פַּחְדּ֖וֹ עַל־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê šêm- dā·wîḏ bə·ḵāl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ Yah·weh nā·ṯan ’eṯ- paḥ·dōw ‘al- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: And David’s fame went out into every land and the LORD caused all nations to fear him . . .
verses.literalPt: A fama de Davi espalhou-se por todas as terras; e Jeová fez que todas as nações tivessem medo dele.
